sources.note: Main homepage. Shows iPatientCare as integrated EHR, Practice Management, Billing, and RCM suite. Also reveals a full Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) product with 20+ modules (blood bank, OR management, CSSD, etc.) — appears to be a separate product line, possibly for international markets.

About page. Key finding: iPatientCare was acquired by AssureCare in 2019. AssureCare has been providing population health management solutions since 1998. iPatientCare has served providers for over 20 years across the U.S. and globally.

EHR product page. Describes patient engagement suite (portal with demographics, lab results, messaging, refill requests, appointments), telehealth (audio/video/chat), customizable specialty templates, quality reporting (MU, MIPS, MACRA, 63 eCQMs), and interoperability (HIE, immunization registries, lab/imaging systems, pharmacies).

Practice management page. Describes front office (registration, scheduling, eligibility verification, multi-location) and back office (claims submission, clearinghouse integration, denial management, billing reports, AR management).

RCM page. Describes outsourced billing service option: claims entry/editing, AR follow-up, denials/appeals, eligibility verification, referral tracking, electronic remittance/payment posting, payer credentialing.

HIMS product page. Full hospital management suite with 20+ modules (ADT, bed/ward management, OT management, pharmacy, lab, radiology, blood bank, CSSD, diet/kitchen, linen/laundry, HR, asset management, equipment maintenance). References NABH/NABL/JCI/CAP/NMC standards — appears targeted at international (India) markets.

Target market page. Serves primary care, specialty practices (mental/behavioral health, cardiology, pain management, orthopedics, pediatrics, internal medicine, women's health), community health centers, rural health clinics, and pharmacies.
ONC mandatory disclosures / certified health IT page. Mostly a contact form; minimal content visible without form submission.
Capterra reviews (4.4/5, 66 reviews). Users praise ease of use, integrated billing/claims, customer support. Some note sluggish performance and desire for more templates.
G2 reviews (3.8/5, 2 reviews). Described as great for charting, paperless workflow, easy scheduling and prescribing.
Software Advice profile. Confirms EHR + practice management + e-prescribing. Meaningful Use, HIPAA, MIPS certified.
SelectHub profile. Confirms integrated EHR, practice management, billing, compliance tools.
Definitive Healthcare top ambulatory EHR vendors list. iPatientCare is NOT in the top 10, confirming <2% ambulatory market share.

AssureCare's MedCompass PHM platform page. Confirms AssureCare is a large PHM company (50M+ members, 15M+ medical decisions/year). MedCompass is the parent company's separate platform for care management, utilization management, medication therapy management.
TechRadar review. Confirms cloud/on-premise options, mobile access, Google Glass app. Notes Android app is less developed than iOS/desktop.
Software Finder reviews. Describes product as 'not innovative, pretty basic, gets the job done.' Confirms document management, lab integration, and customizable templates.
FindEMR profile. Confirms document management (scanned records, referrals, consent forms), E/M coding support, customizable templates.
ITQlick profile. Confirms lab orders/results integration, drug interaction checks, e-prescribing including EPCS.
